title: Candidate velocity playbook (daily) - Mila
body:
Morning snapshot (07:30 PST) - quick run through
- Today focus: clear 6 scheduling blocks, push 4 offer follow-ups, tidy pending take-home coding tests (2).
- High priority: CC-157 (N. Alvarez) timezone mismatch (GMT+1) - needs interview window before Fri 16th to meet hiring team's SLA.
- Medium: CC-162 (K. Osei) requested manager loop; recruiting lead approved, need to confirm panel availability.
- Low: CC-145 (J. Patel) asked for status update on comp; send standard salary expectations note.

Top morning TODOs (order matters)
1) Slot rescue: 9:00–10:30 PST open for last-minute reschedules - check for conflicts with ENG hiring manager calendar (Samir).
2) Follow-up email batch: 10 candidates flagged as "awaiting response" - use template A (attached below) + personalize 1 line.
3) Send offer follow-up: CC-149, CC-153, CC-160 - escalate to recruiting lead if no reply in 48h.
4) Chase take-home tests: ping hiring team for CC-155 + set deadline reminder for candidate (72h).
5) Update candidate tracker sheet: mark timezone, stage, last_contact, next_action.

Notes-to-self / things I forget if I don't write them down
- Always include time zone in calendar invite subject (TZ: PST / GMT+1).
- Use "Flex interview" tag when candidate asked for nonstandard hours.
- If candidate wants remote whiteboard, add "RemoteWB" link in invite.

Candidate-specific quick snippets (for copy-paste)
- N. Alvarez (CC-157) - "Thanks Nora — are you available Thu 4/15 between 09:00-12:00 GMT+1 or Fri 4/16 between 13:00-16:00 GMT+1? Panel will be 45m with Eng Manager + SWE."
- K. Osei (CC-162) - "Hiring manager confirmed for Tue 4/20 11:00 PST. Panel includes Alice (SWE), Tom (SWE). Can you do 11:00?"
- J. Patel (CC-145) - "We expect an update on comp by EOD Wed; I'm following up with hiring manager now and will share when I have it."

Scheduling blockers & actions
- Hiring manager double-booked Fri afternoon (Tom) — ask for alternate (Alice or Samir) or switch to asynchronous take-home. Action: ping Samir now.
- Zoom account limit for concurrent interviews at 11:00 PST — move noncritical 11:15 to 12:00.

Templates (short)
- Template A (quick follow-up): "Hi {name}, checking in — are you still interested in the {role}? We'd love to move forward and are hoping to schedule the next interview within the next week. Best, Mila"
- Template B (offer nudger): "Hi {name}, quick nudge on the offer sent on {date}. If you have questions or need time, happy to help — can we set a call?"

Staging checklist for candidate readouts
- Confirm interview panel availability + backup names (1 backup per role).
- Confirm tech setup: Zoom link, shared doc for take-home, whiteboard permissions.
- Add calendar buffer: 10m before + 5m after for notes.

End-of-day wrap (placeholders for later)
- 17:30 PST quick tally: scheduled interviews today, responses, offers moved forward.
- Notes to recruiter rotation: leave handoff comment with outstanding actions + candidate priorities.

Random quick links/refs I keep using
- Shared scheduling sheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/d/sched123
- Interview playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/TA/Interview+Playbook

Open questions / escalate
- Should we allow candidates to propose interview times in other timezones proactively? (Pros: faster scheduling; Cons: more manual alignment) — ask hiring ops sync Thu.
- Do we have a drop-in for after-hours candidates (S.E. APAC)? Explore rotating late-shift coverage with team.

Housekeeping: remind payroll of new hire start dates (weekly batch Fri)
- Add CC-149, CC-153 to Friday batch if acceptances come in this week.

——
Drafts (snippets I reuse)
- "Thanks again for your time today — next steps: we're wrapping up panel feedback and will follow up by EOD Tue with next steps."
- Quick scheduler note to hiring manager: "Can you hold 45m on Thu AM as tentative? Will confirm by Wed EOD."

Small wins / metrics I care about (measure weekly)
- Average time to first interview after app: target < 3 days
- Candidate response rate to scheduling outreach: target > 70%
- Offers accepted / extended: rolling % - track weekly

Today's micro-plan (tick when done)
- [ ] Rescue 2 overlapping windows (9:00 slot)
- [ ] Send 6 follow-ups (template A + 1 line)
- [ ] Confirm panel for CC-162
- [ ] Update tracker sheet + timezone column for 8 candidates
- [ ] Ping hiring manager about comp for CC-145
- [ ] Prep 2 calendar invites with RemoteWB instructions

Quick end note: breathe. prioritize "holds that block others" first (panel confirmations, manager availability).
summary: Daily personal recruiting coordinator playbook: prioritized scheduling + follow-ups, candidate snippets, templates, blockers, and micro-checklist for Mila.
